node.title: Re: Printing to STDOUT buffered when invoking Perl within a bash-script using tee
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
Hi [TJCooper],

Sounds like you are [http://perl.plover.com/FAQs/Buffering.html|Suffering from Buffering]. In your Perl script, turn on autoflush via $|=1;.

Hope this helps,
-- Hauke D
